verse_calendar.description: Verse of the day by the phone's local date: {"2026-10-21": "ISA 40:31"}. References use the app's 3-letter book ids, e.g. "LAM 3:22-23". Days with no entry use fallback_verse.

fallback_verse.description: Verse for days missing from verse_calendar. Empty or unreadable means GEN 1:1.

card_styles.description: Card styles: order, hidden (style ids), styles (id -> name, tags, hidden_variants, variants, layout). An unbundled id with a layout adds a style. {} = as bundled. See remote_card_styles.example.json.

defaultValue.value: I've been turning Bible verses into quote cards with Snippet. Try it: https://snippetverses.app

invite_message.description: Text sent by Profile > Invite a friend. Empty means the bundled message.

share_caption.description: Caption sent with a shared card. Placeholders: {reference} (Psalm 46:10), {translation} (KJV), {verse} (verse text), {reference_line} (PSALM 46:10 · KJV). Empty means the bundled caption.
